variables_needed: duration (top and base ages) of individual stratigraphic formations or units
fossil species durations (first and last appearance) or speciation timescales
within-formation ancestor-descendant morphological series (rare; occurrence-level data with stratigraphic position)

datasets.name: Macrostrat API v2 (units)

checked.method: GET units?all&response=short; the limit parameter was ignored so the full 17,435,801-byte response was downloaded once to /tmp (over the 1 MB guideline), parsed locally and deleted

variables_present: pbdb_collections and pbdb_occurrences counts per unit
variables_missing: formation-level (rather than unit-level) durations are not given directly; formations must be aggregated from units
datasets.scope: 35,481 unit records returned, of which 22,102 carry a non-empty Fm name. API response states licence CC-BY 4.0.
datasets.evidence: Parsed JSON keys: Fm, Gp, Mbr, SGp, b_age, col_area, col_id, max_thick, min_thick, outcrop, pbdb_collections, pbdb_occurrences, project_id, section_id, strat_name_id, t_age, unit_id, unit_name. Also GET defs/columns returned 200 and defs/intervals returned 200 (7,332 bytes).

datasets.name: Paleobiology Database (PBDB) data service 1.2

checked.method: GET occs/list.csv base_name=Bivalvia limit=0 show=time rowcount

datasets.scope: Records Found 211,953 occurrences for Bivalvia. Metazoa taxon record reports 1,361,166 occurrences.
datasets.evidence: CSV header begins occurrence_no, record_type, reid_no, flags, collection_no, identified_name, identified_rank, identified_no, difference, accepted_name, accepted_rank, accepted_no, early_interval, late_interval, max_ma...

datasets.name: International Commission on Stratigraphy

checked.method: HEAD -L stratigraphy.org; GET Macrostrat defs/intervals for the international periods timescale

variables_present: interval names with t_age and b_age (e.g. Quaternary 0 to 2.58 Ma) via Macrostrat's copy of the international timescale
variables_missing: radiometric dates of individual formation boundaries
datasets.scope: Landing page reachable (200). Interval ages are served through Macrostrat, not by stratigraphy.org directly.
datasets.evidence: Macrostrat JSON lists int_id 421 Quaternary, t_age 0, b_age 2.58, int_type period.

datasets.name: TimeTree
variables_present: molecular divergence times (not inspected; landing page only)
datasets.scope: http://www.timetree.org/ redirected to https://timetree.org/. API and download terms not examined.

search_log.note: units with t_age/b_age; 22,102 with Fm name

summary: Macrostrat (CC-BY 4.0) supplies base and top ages for 35,481 units, 22,102 named by formation, with PBDB occurrence counts per unit, and PBDB supplies occurrence-level first/last appearances (211,953 for Bivalvia), so formation durations and fossil species durations are both obtainable; an independent speciation-time estimate is not.
next_step: Aggregate Macrostrat units to formations, pick clades in PBDB for species durations, and pre-register what counts as an adequately sampled within-formation series; do not use the molecular speciation arm until TimeTree access is checked.
obstacles_confirmed: Macrostrat's limit parameter was ignored in the call used, so a single call returned 17 MB (over the 1 MB guideline); it was parsed locally and deleted.
No dataset found gives independent speciation durations.
